formulas.formula: Your shifts, differentials and overtime turned into a real budget. Made for 12s, nights and weekends.
1. Setup: your base hourly rate, shift differentials, overtime rule, taxes and one pay period start date.
2. Shift Log: every shift you work. Shift type, hours, holiday, on-call. Pay is figured for you, overtime included.
3. Paychecks: see each pay period's estimate. Type your real take-home from your stub to catch pay mistakes.
4. Budget and Transactions: plan your month and log what you spend.
5. Licenses & CEUs: never miss a renewal again.
6. Dashboard and Monthly: shifts, hours, overtime, pay and spending at a glance.
Weekend differential is added automatically for Saturday and Sunday shifts.
Hours past your weekly limit (Sun to Sat) get the overtime premium, in the order you worked them.
If your real pay is far from the estimate, the Paychecks tab flags it. Payroll mistakes happen.
Pay swings with your schedule. Budget for a normal month and save the extra-shift money.
Clear the white cells on Shift Log, Paychecks (real pay), Transactions, Budget and Licenses.
Tinted cells: these calculate for you.
Green: OK, matches, or money left.
Red: check your stub, renew now, over budget, or something to check.
Thank you for everything you do. Now take care of your money too.
